items.title: Sunshine 'hero' shop owner dies from alleged assault injuries
items.description: Van Viet Truong, 60, was hailed as a hero after coming to the aid of a fellow retail worker after five youths tried to rob a store in Sunshine.

items.title: Year by year, Sydney's winter wonderland is fading into memory
items.description: New South Wales is in the middle of its 30th consecutive warmer than average winter — and a past staple of the season is rapidly vanishing.

items.title: Is Jetstar's new bag policy really just following the rest of the world?
items.description: Jetstar says charging passengers to use overhead lockers brings it into line with many overseas low-cost airlines. But is "unbundling" fees and charges actually making it more expensive to fly budget?

items.title: Wall Street debt binge could end in tears — and lost billions
items.description: Credit default swaps for US big tech companies are soaring to record highs. It means investors are fearful of a major Wall Street company collapse.

items.title: Gambling ad reforms at risk as Labor draws line on major changes
items.description: Labor is unlikely to entertain major changes to its gambling ad crackdown despite the bill being "friendless" in parliament.

items.title: Labor's migration test looks different to Howard's
items.description: If stopping asylum seeker boats was the great immigration challenge in decades past, achieving a lower Net Overseas Migration (NOM) figure has become the new political test.

items.title: AI model used fake identities 'unprompted' to deceive humans in a safety test
items.description: The British government's AI Security Institute has released a report showing AI models from OpenAI and Anthropic had, in test conditions, engaged in "harmful activity directed at real people and organisations".

items.title: 'It becomes never-ending': Carnival cruise crew reveal punishing conditions
items.description: Passengers boarding a Carnival cruise ship are promised a world of endless food, relaxation and oceanic luxury. But for the crew who make these escapes possible, life is vastly different.

items.title: Battery-powered households not signing up to 'virtual power plant' scheme
items.description: Thousands of households with batteries installed under the federal government's scheme are choosing not to sign up to be a so-called virtual power plant that sells stored energy back to the grid.

items.title: We've never seen the Sun in this much detail before
items.description: The highest-resolution imagery of the Sun's surface ever taken reveals dizzying currents, and clues about our star's magnetic fields.

items.title: President Trump Announces U.S. Military Airstrike in Venezuela
items.description: President Trump states the U.S. military conducted its first known airstrike inside Venezuela targeting a dock where drugs were allegedly loaded onto boats[1][2][4].

items.title: Trump Meets Netanyahu at Mar-a-Lago for Gaza Ceasefire Phase Two Talks
items.description: President Trump met with Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu to discuss advancing phase two of the Gaza ceasefire, including reconstruction and responses to Iran[1][4].

items.title: Feds Launch Massive Taxpayer Fraud Probe in Minnesota After Viral Video
items.description: Federal agencies including DHS, FBI, and ICE investigate $110 million in suspected fraud at Minnesota child care centers following a viral YouTube video[3].

items.title: Americans Express Widespread Opposition to AI Data Centers
items.description: Public backlash against AI infrastructure data centers grows, with protests and demands for bans influencing Democratic Party strategies for future elections[3].

items.title: Elon Musk's Humanoid Robot Vision: China Poised to Lead Production
items.description: China prioritizes humanoid robots in tech race with U.S., ramping up production while warning of industry bubble and potential bottlenecks[3].

items.title: Trump-Putin Call Amid Ukraine-Russia Tensions Over Peace Plan
items.description: President Trump spoke with Putin amid ongoing Ukraine conflict, with Russia reevaluating peace plan tenets after Ukrainian denials[1].

items.title: Democratic Gubernatorial Candidates in Wisconsin Focus on Inflation and Trump
items.description: Seven Democrats vying for Wisconsin governor blame economic issues on Trump and emphasize affordability ahead of 2026 primary[3].
